mil7.3.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, niyyāmakassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.3.8:1.2: Yathā mahārāja niyyāmako rattindivaṃ satataṃ samitaṃ appamatto yattapayatto nāvaṃ sāreti,
mil7.3.8:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena cittaṃ niyāmayamānena rattindivaṃ satataṃ samitaṃ appamattena yoniso manasikārena cittaṃ niyāmetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.8:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja niyyāmakassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.8:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Dhammapade:
mil7.3.8:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja niyyāmakassa yaṃ kiñci mahāsamudde kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā sabban-taṃ viditaṃ hoti,
mil7.3.8:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kusalākusalaṃ sāvajjānavajjaṃ hīna-ppaṇītaṃ kaṇha-sukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ vijānitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.8:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja niyyāmakassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.8:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja niyyāmako yante muddikaṃ deti: mā koci yantaṃ āmasitthāti,
mil7.3.8:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena citte saṃvara-muddikā dātabbā: mā kañci pāpakaṃ akusalavitakkaṃ vitakkesīti. Idaṃ mahārāja niyyāmakassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.8:4.3: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Saṃyuttanikāyavare:
mil7.3.8:4.4: Mā bhikkhave pāpake akusale vitakke vitakkayitth seyyathīdaṃ:
